_about: 0048-add1 §ب (Talal 14 October 09:23): «أذكار الصباح والمساء» (HadeethEnc category 301) as two lists, «أذكار الصباح» and «أذكار المساء». Each hadith goes to the list (or both) its own text names, the word it is built on in `basis`, verbatim from the text; `segments` are the indices of its entry in data/adhkar-highlights.json shown in that list (a list highlights its own wording where the text has it, and nothing is written that is not in the source). Draft: shown to no one until the coordinator has reviewed it (status «reviewed»); until then the app keeps the one list (web/src/v2/daily/flags.ts ADHKAR_SPLIT).

basis.morning: ومن قالها من النهار … فمات من يومه قبل أن يمسي
basis.evening: ومن قالها من الليل … فمات قبل أن يصبح

basis.morning: خرج من عندها بكرة حين صلى الصبح

basis.evening: لم تصبه فجأة بلاء، حتى يصبح
